posts.text:
Everyone loved the dashboard.
Nobody changed a decision.

Pretty metrics are decoration until they alter behavior.

Daily AI pro tip:
Choose one painful metric that drives action. In content ops, "published with valid media" is often more honest than "generated successfully."

Stale context is the quiet failure mode.

Your model can be technically accurate and operationally wrong when your source is yesterday.

Daily AI pro tip:
Add freshness metadata to retrieval sources and enforce expiry checks in your pipeline.

Postmortems fail when they read like PR.

Clear beats elegant: what failed, why it failed, and what changes before the next run.

Daily AI pro tip:
Probe final media files (audio stream, duration, codec, resolution) before scheduling. Most publish errors are preventable.

"Just automate the email" sounds efficient until one message creates the wrong commitment.

Communication workflows need explicit send boundaries.

Daily AI pro tip:
Automate drafting freely. Keep send actions gated unless policy logic is proven under real edge cases.
